description: This file defines the UserProfileItem interface with methods related to user profile configuration options such as dashboard selection, graph selection, live data, and units.

classes.name: UserProfileItem
classes.description: A Java interface representing user profile configuration options in the RomRaider project.

methods.name: isDashSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the dashboard is selected for the user profile.

methods.name: isGraphSelected
methods.description: Returns whether graph display is selected for the user profile.

methods.name: isLiveDataSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether live data is selected for the user profile.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Retrieves the units preference in the user profile.
